verdict.rationale: Docs describe prebuilt per-project dashboards covering token usage and error/trace metrics, cost-based threshold alerts, and custom dashboards that can group by run tag/metadata (e.g., model, time period) — directly matching the cost/token usage dashboard story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of per-model cost breakdown accuracy and no explicit screenshot/example of a 'cost by model over time' chart.
